Name: Seed Vending Machine
Author: StuykGaming
Description:
[size=5][b]Seed Vending Machine[/b][/size]

[b][size=2]Problem[/size]

[/b]You just ran out of time in the day to go to Pierre's shop, and you want to get some seeds to plant before the next day.
You also want to get some seeds for the next season in a few days to prepare.

[b][size=2]Solution[/size][/b]

Pierre just set up a new vending machine in front of his shop.

There is a vending machine [b]in front of Pierre's[/b] that offers seasonal seeds for the current season and a few for the next season at any time of day.

Seeds are available at a [b]1.1% price increase[/b], with limited daily stock.

[b]Requirements
[/b]
[list]
[*]ContentPatcher
[*]ExtraMapLayers
[*]ExpandedPreconditionsUtility
[*]ShopTileFramework
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[size=2]This mod [b]should be compatible with 99% of texture replacement mods[/b]. We utilize ExtraMapLayers to add ensure its in front of all texture replacements / mods.[/size]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Requirements
[*]Extract this Mod into Mods Folder
[/list]
[b]Tweaking[/b]
[size=2]If you need to modify anything in the shops, go to Mods/SeedVendingMachines/[STF] Vending Machines and modify the `shops.json` file. Everything is currently commented on with a full list of available seeds and saplings.[/size]
